description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Junktroller with haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki, adding {C}{C}.
Activate the Junktroller token by tapping it, putting Kiki-Jiki from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Kiki-Jiki into your graveyard from the bottom of your library and then putting Kiki-Jiki onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
